name: Welcome to Paradise Task Tracker 👋
description_html:
Hello! This sample project is your playground for trying the app. Click around and see how everything works without worrying about breaking anything.

Each work item here is designed to teach you the basics. Follow them one by one, at your own pace.

Try this first

  1. Look in the Properties section below, on the State: Todo row.

  2. Click it and change it to Done from the dropdown. Or drag the card to the Done column.

name: 1. Get to know the department board 🎯
description_html:
Work in Paradise Task Tracker is grouped by department and division. Every department has its own board.

Open the project list in the sidebar to see your department board.
description_stripped: Work in Paradise Task Tracker is grouped by department and division. Every department has its own board.Open the project list in the sidebar to see your department board.

name: 2. Invite your teammates 🤜🤛
description_html:
Work goes better when everyone is here. Ask an admin to add your teammates to the same department.

Department members can automatically see and work on the items on its board.
description_stripped: Work goes better when everyone is here. Ask an admin to add your teammates to the same department.Department members can automatically see and work on the items on its board.

name: 3. Create and assign work items ✏️
description_html:
Click Add work item, give it a title, then pick an assignee, a priority and a due date.

Work items can be split into sub-items, labelled, and given attachments or comments.

name: 4. See your work through views 🔮
description_html: Switch between list, board, calendar and spreadsheet from the top bar. Save the filters you use often as a view so you can reopen them in one click.
description_stripped: Switch between list, board, calendar and spreadsheet from the top bar. Save the filters you use often as a view so you can reopen them in one click.

name: 5. Set your preferences ⚙️
description_html: Open Settings to choose your language, time zone, theme and the notifications you want to receive.
